title: Pedestal Pro Oscillator
body:
Adjustable height. Oscillating head. The fan that follows you around the room (not literally, that would be creepy).

Features:
- Adjustable height 36"-54"
- 90° oscillation
- 3 speeds
- Tilt-adjustable head
- Weighted base
summary: Adjustable height. Oscillating head. The fan that follows you around the room (not literally).
